segments.name: Potash
segments.description: Produces and sells potash as fertilizer, animal feed nutrient, and industrial input, along with mining byproducts.
segments.evidence: We sell potash into three primary markets: the agricultural market as a fertilizer input, the animal feed market as a nutrient supplement, and the industrial market as a component in drilling and fracturing fluids for oil and gas wells and an input to other industrial processes.

segments.name: Trio®
segments.description: Produces a low-chloride specialty fertilizer delivering potassium, sulfur, and magnesium in a single particle for domestic and international crop markets.
segments.evidence: Trio ® is our specialty fertilizer that is low in chloride and delivers potassium, sulfur, and magnesium in a single particle.

segments.name: Oilfield Solutions
segments.description: Sells water and oilfield-related products and services to support oil and gas development in the Permian Basin.
segments.evidence: Our water sales and other products and services offered through our oilfield solutions segment are driven by demand from oil and gas exploration companies drilling in the Permian Basin.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for potash, Trio®, salt, water, and other products at quoted prices on a delivered or plant pick-up basis, with sales determined by quantities sold and prices realized.
revenueModel.evidence: For potash, Trio ® , and salt, we quote prices to customers both on a delivered basis and on the basis of pick-up at our plants and warehouses.
